Quest_board: ^This is where the player can find random quests. Potentially it can be in the form of advertisements and such in the town square to stay in character. These quests are essentially only providing finantial incentive, as story quests make more sense to come from NPCs personally. There are a few randomly generated quests available at any given time, and when the player gets down to only 2 remaining they could regenerate, potentially once a day. The quests could be time bound as well, having a timer before disapearing regardless. This could allow for quests being ranked in such a way that the more valuable quests are only available for short periods of time, whereas others may be more lenient. This would also require that there is some type of ingame clock, although it can be sped up dramatically.
